lat: mchit l s-suq l-bare7
en: I went to the market yesterday.

lat: ma mchitch l l-khedma l-yum
en: I didn't go to work today.

lat: wach mchiti l l-mghrib f s-sif
en: Did you go to Morocco in the summer?

lat: 3lech ma mchitich m3a khuk
en: Why didn't you go with your brother?

lat: mchiti l l-madrasa bkri bezzaf
en: You went to school very early.

lat: ma mchitich l l-7efla l-bare7
en: You didn't go to the party yesterday.

lat: huwa mcha l t-tbib f s-sba7
en: He went to the doctor in the morning.

lat: ma mchach l l-jami3a had n-nhar
en: He didn't go to university today.

lat: khti mchat l l-bosta l-bare7
en: My sister went to the post office yesterday.

lat: hiya ma mchatch m3a sa7btha
en: She didn't go with her friend.

lat: mchina l l-b7er b t-tobis
en: We went to the beach by bus.

lat: ma mchinach l r-rbat f l-3utla
en: We didn't go to Rabat during the holiday.

lat: wach ntuma mchitu l d-dar
en: Did you go home?

lat: ma mchituch l l-qahwa m3ana
en: You didn't go to the cafe with us.

lat: s-s7ab dyali mchaw l s-sinima
en: My friends went to the cinema.

lat: huma ma mchawch l l-3ers
en: They didn't go to the wedding.

lat: kanmchi l l-khedma 3la rjliya
en: I go to work on foot.

lat: ma kanmchich l s-sinima f l-lil
en: I don't go to the cinema at night.

lat: nta dima katmchi l l-qahwa
en: You always go to the cafe.

lat: 3lech ma katmchich l l-mel3ab
en: Why don't you go to the stadium?

lat: katmchi l l-madrasa kul sba7
en: You go to school every morning.

lat: nti ma katmchich l l-7emmam
en: You don't go to the public bath.

lat: baba kaymchi l l-jami3 kul jem3a
en: My father goes to the mosque every Friday.

lat: huwa ma kaymchich b t-tran
en: He doesn't go by train.

lat: khti katmchi l l-khedma b t-tumubil
en: My sister goes to work by car.

lat: hiya ma katmchich l s-suq kul yum
ar: هي ما كتمشيش للسوق كل يوم
en: She doesn't go to the market every day.

lat: 7na kanmchiw l l-b7er f s-sif
en: We go to the beach in the summer.

lat: ma kanmchiwch l r-rbat bezzaf
en: We don't go to Rabat a lot.

lat: wach ntuma katmchiw m3ana
en: Do you (pl.) go with us?

lat: ntuma ma katmchiwch l t-tbib bkri
en: You don't go to the doctor early.

lat: d-drari kaymchiw l l-madrasa daba
en: The children go to school now.

lat: huma ma kaymchiwch l l-khedma l-yum
en: They don't go to work today.

lat: ana ghadi nmchi l d-dar daba
en: I am going to go home now.

lat: ma ghadich nmchi l s-suq ghda
en: I am not going to go to the market tomorrow.

lat: wach ghadi tmchi m3ana l l-b7er
en: Are you going to go with us to the beach?

lat: nta ma ghadich tmchi l l-khedma
en: You are not going to go to work.

lat: wach ghadi tmchi l l-7efla ghda
en: Are you going to go to the party tomorrow?

lat: nti ma ghadich tmchi bu7dek
en: You are not going to go alone.

lat: huwa ghadi ymchi l l-mghrib had ch-chher
ar: هو غادي يمشي للمغرب هاد الشهر
en: He is going to go to Morocco this month.

lat: ma ghadich ymchi l l-jami3a ghda
en: He is not going to go to university tomorrow.

lat: khti ghadi tmchi l t-tbib f l-3chiya
en: My sister is going to go to the doctor in the afternoon.

lat: hiya ma ghadich tmchi l s-sinima
en: She is not going to go to the cinema.

lat: 7na ghadi nmchiw l r-rbat f t-tran
en: We are going to go to Rabat by train.

lat: ma ghadich nmchiw l l-3ers l-lila
en: We are not going to go to the wedding tonight.

lat: wach ntuma ghadi tmchiw m3a baba
ar: واش نتوما غادي تمشيو مع بابا
en: Are you going to go with my father?

lat: ntuma ma ghadich tmchiw l l-khedma ghda
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تمشيو للخدمة غدا
en: You are not going to go to work tomorrow.

lat: huma ghadi ymchiw l l-mdina l-qdima
en: They are going to go to the old city.

lat: s-s7ab dyali ma ghadich ymchiw l-yum
ar: الصحاب ديالي ما غاديش يمشيو اليوم
en: My friends are not going to go today.
